title: HIIT-based Exercise Intervention for Improvement of Immunomodulatory, Cardiopulmonary, and Psychosocial Parameters During Maintenance Therapy of Paediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (HEALL)
official: HIIT-based Exercise Intervention for Improvement of Immunomodulatory, Cardiopulmonary, and Psychosocial Parameters During Maintenance Therapy of Paediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (HEALL)
summary: In this study, the investigators aim to examine the effects of high-intensity interval training (HIIT) on cardiopulmonary fitness and immunological recovery in female ALL survivors who underwent cancer treatment during childhood and adolescence.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed acute lymphatic leukemia
* Begin of maintenance therapy
* From 6 to 10 years of age
* Physical ability to participate in HIIT and cardiopulmonary exercise testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known pleural or pericardial effusion
* Critical condition (requiring respiratory support, ventilation, oxygen, shock, symptomatic heart failure)
* Marked thoracic deformities/malformations
* Previous lung surgery
* Injuries that do not allow physical stress diagnostics

sites.f: University Hospital Erlangen, Department for childhood and adolescence medicine
